recall.question: A box is 30 cm long, 20 cm wide and 10 cm tall. Two crossed ribbon loops go around it, plus 25 cm for the bow. How much ribbon is that?
recall.why: Each loop goes around one horizontal side and the height: 2 × (30 + 10) + 2 × (20 + 10) = 140 cm, so the height counts four times. Add the 25 cm bow: 165 cm.
